s1-10.global_nm_coordinate: 0.5 × (midpoint_rc + [9,9]); row/column order is a rigid coordinate rotation for the square-block geometry.

s1-5.global_nm_coordinate: 0.5 × (midpoint_rc + [40,40]); row/column order is a rigid coordinate rotation for the square-block geometry.

data_status.s1-10: Previously examined central crop; only two qualifying width pairs were available there. The present full-field series is an extension of that same acquisition and does not constitute an independent scan.
data_status.s1-5: The warning protocol applies a threshold developed on MoS2 to this fresh graphene scan. The aperture and geometry gates were applied before inspecting the scan-level warning outcome; it is a retrospective within-study check with shared team and instrument.
data_status.s1-6: The v004 protocol describes this as a fresh acquisition in the February series with the observer and aperture fixed before scoring; it remains in the same publication, instrument and collaboration, and the full scan was opened for geometry and width extraction.

estimand.cohorts: s1-6 and s1-10 use the frozen all-model-qualified paired width sets. s1-5 primary repeats the prior opposite-triplet matched subsets for its warning diagnostic; all-qualified s1-5 medians are included as sensitivity cohorts.
estimand.measured_gap_nm: Per selected wall, first-order apparent width minus second-order apparent width. Report median over the qualified wall cohort.
estimand.model_gap_nm: Same signed difference from saved periodic or isolated model width fits on the same wall cohort.
estimand.model_minus_experiment_median_gap_nm: Median of model-predicted wall gaps minus median measured wall gap, calculated on each paired spatial-block resample.
estimand.resampling_unit: Occupied spatial blocks within each fixed scan; each sampled block carries paired measured and model width records.

limits: The three acquisitions are separate scans but share publication, instrument and research group; no independent specimen crosswalk is available in the saved records.

Spatial-block intervals condition on saved wall selection, aperture, fitted widths, and model predictions. They do not include aperture, probe, image registration, model or between-acquisition uncertainty.
Block-size factors and origin phases expose sensitivity to spatial dependence assumptions; the saved records do not empirically identify a correlation length.
s1-10 uses a full-field extension after a small crop was viewed. s1-5 is an additional retrospective warning test. These do not constitute blinded external validation.

resampling.block_side: factor × sqrt(2/sqrt(3)) × median same-family wall spacing on the resampled qualified cohort; triangular-cell-area approximation.
resampling.cluster_rule: Sample the occupied blocks of the width-qualified cohort with replacement, drawing the same number of occupied blocks. Include every qualified wall in each selected block, preserving case pairing and duplicate block draws.
resampling.interval: P5–P95 percentile ranges, conditional spatial sensitivity within the fixed scan geometry.
resampling.spatial_origin: Minimum saved wall midpoint coordinates over all geometry-selected cases; crop-relative row/column coordinates are translated by the frozen region origin and converted using the published 0.5 nm raster spacing. Four half-block origin phases are pooled.

s1-5_common_eight_section_window_compari.definition: Intersect per-window width qualification and paired opposite-triplet readout availability across adaptive and fixed half-windows; use the same eight saved wall chords at both windows.

0.5.statistic: Fixed-window minus adaptive-window; both windows are resampled with the same sampled wall blocks.

1.0.statistic: Fixed-window minus adaptive-window; both windows are resampled with the same sampled wall blocks.

1.5.statistic: Fixed-window minus adaptive-window; both windows are resampled with the same sampled wall blocks.

limits: Percentile ranges are conditional within-scan spatial resampling sensitivity for these fixed saved walls, with per-wall measured and model widths paired inside each sampled block.
No acquisition-level or independent-specimen uncertainty is estimated; the public records do not provide an independent-device crosswalk.
The block length and origin phase are plausible spatial-clustering sensitivity choices, not empirically measured correlation lengths.

yardstick_interpretation.recommendation: Retain opposite-spot disagreement as an empirical within-wall repeatability scale; report it with its own paired-wall denominator. Use the spatial-block P5–P95 ranges for conditional uncertainty of scan-level medians. Neither quantity is a device-level or specimen-level confidence interval.
